read: turns [00:00] Medi 'Right. Okay.' .. [1:04:26] CHAT Amal 'enbasa6tellak / enbasa6etlak' (all 921 turns)
coverage_note: Structure: 00:00-06:26 English chat about a song (lyric words balad/bilaad, saa7et el-bait, 5ubza taught); 06:28-10:40 the only real speaking stretch (date, time, weather, clothes); 11:13-1:00:35 a listening drill - Amal says a verb sentence, Medi translates to English, so almost every row is mode=listening and his 'medi_said' is an English translation; 1:00:39-end scheduling in English. Speaking rows: 06:37/07:03 date number, 07:50 b- present for past (B5), 09:36 ree7a didn't-know, 10:25 8aame2 supplied, 38:13 ma t7ammasi -> ma tet7ammasi (B12), 44:44 bazha2 for zah2aan. Engine notes: 07:38 Amal 'سنتين وته' = tentan u tult (her chat); 20:04 Medi 'بيساع' = his echo of بيزعل; 38:48 'أُمه safulu' + 38:59 'By all eight' = humme t2assafuli (echo: 'Wait. Asafulu.' = اتأسفوا لي, 39:02); 51:24 Amal 'عمسني' = حمسني (her chat 7ammasni); 44:50 'zar-zarha, zar'a' = his attempt at zah2aan; 47:22 'it's just too much fucked' = garbled echo of za3ajto; 53:51 'home' = -hom of زهقتهم; 1:02:02 'شوفك' = ashoofak with dropped a- (S4). Echo candidates checked: 'Oh, the smell.' 09:40, 'Smile.' 45:17, 'Bored.' 44:38, 'Or who enjoyed?' 42:33 are real English, not Arabic sound-alikes. Not errors (left out): 06:33 ثلاث self-fix to يوم السبت; 08:54 'أبل امبارح or ...?' is a question she confirmed (قبل امبارح); 09:56-10:05 بياض/أبيض/بيضة he reached بيضا himself and she only echoed بيضة; 10:08 بلوزة -> قميص رسمي self-fix; 30:19 and 57:50 he offered both readings and she picked one; 41:10 إنتي خربتي السفرة correct production; 48:27 'was-- no, is' self-fix; 1:00:47 أحسن كتير اليوم accepted. No tier-3 English-in-Arabic slips found: his English is whole-clause meta talk. Names: Palestine, Spanish ('[in Spanish]' at 30:40 is an engine tag, not a word he said).

rows.medi_said: Does balad mean like bilad? Like, balad.
rows.amal_said: بلد is one, بلاد is multiple. بلاد is another way of saying countries.
rows.why: Didn't-know from the song: he asked whether balad relates to bilaad; Amal taught بلد = one country, بلاد = countries (her sheet has only country = دولة).

rows.medi_said: Does it come from, like, Sakit? No? صح؟
rows.amal_said: No, it's from ساحة. ساحة is a yard, house yard.
rows.why: Didn't-know from the lyric: he guessed the root of sa7et and Amal supplied ساحة = yard (sheet: house yard | Sa7et el-bait | ساحة البيت).

rows.amal_said: خبزة is a loaf.
rows.why: Amal taught a lyric word he never attempted (sheet: a loaf of bread | 5ubza | خبزة); filed as a didn't-know, tier 0.

rows.medi_said: This is it today. تسعة عشرين.
rows.why: Saying the date he produced tes3a 3eshreen (nine, twenty) for nineteen; Amal said '19' and he then gave تسعطاش at 06:42 - a wrong form of a number he knows.

rows.medi_said: I said, uh, ستاش، ستة ... تسعش ستة.
rows.amal_said: ستة؟ ... تسعطاش تسعة.
rows.why: Asked '19 شو؟' (which month) he answered ستة (six) for September; Amal queried 'ستة؟' then recast تسعطاش تسعة and he repeated it at 07:15 - wrong number word for the month.

rows.medi_said: بتغي-- بتغير كتير. No, بغير كتير. It's masculine.
rows.amal_said: The؟ It changed؟ ... So تغير، no be. ... It changed؟
rows.chat: el-jaw el-yoam t8ayyar kteer u shob mish m8ayyem
rows.why: He put a present b- on 'the weather changed' (a finished event); Amal named it ('تغير, no be', 'It changed?'), he agreed 'past tense, you're right' and said تغير كتير at 08:18.
rows.english: the weather changed a lot today

rows.medi_said: شو يعني ريحته؟
rows.amal_said: ريحة. ريحت.
rows.why: Didn't-know: he first heard it as 'خمارة?' (09:15) then asked what ريحته means; Amal supplied ريحة (sheet: smell | ree7a | ريحة) and he said 'Oh, the smell'.
rows.english: its smell (the smell of the rain)

rows.medi_said: uh، كمي
rows.amal_said: غامق.
rows.chat: el-yoam balbes 2amees rasmi abyad u ban6aloan azra2 8aame2 u kundara binniyye
rows.why: After بنطلون أزرق he stalled on 'dark' (engine wrote كمي - probably 8aami with the ق dropped, S4) and Amal supplied غامق which he repeated (sheet: dark (color) | 8aameq | غامق); filed tier 0 as a supplied word, not a wrong word.

rows.medi_said: you took a photo or I, I take a photo? I had, had taken a photo? ... So it's اتصورت, right? ... There's no preposition.
rows.amal_said: صورت. ... Is it did you take a photo or did you get-- did you take a photo of yourself؟ Like, did you get photographed؟
rows.right: I got photographed / you got photographed (اتصورت)
rows.why: Listening: he read the t- form اتصورت as 'took a photo' (صورت); Amal contrasted the two and he landed on 'I got photographed' at 12:10.

rows.medi_said: you are tired of me.
rows.amal_said: No that's تعبت مني. تعبتني.
rows.why: Listening: ta33abetni (you made me tired, -ni object) read as 'tired of me' (تعبت مني); Amal said no and he fixed to 'you tire me / you tired me'.

rows.medi_said: Why did you smile to a male or why did she smile?
rows.amal_said: Is it did or do؟ ... Why are you smiling؟ Why do you smile؟
rows.right: Why do you smile / why are you smiling (بتضحك)
rows.why: Listening: b- present بتضحك translated as past 'did you smile'; Amal prompted 'did or do?' and he fixed to present.

rows.medi_said: Isn't this to inflict sadness? The past tense. ... Okay, I was sad.
rows.amal_said: That's زهقت. زهقت. ... زهقت مش زعلت. زهقت.
rows.right: I was bored / you were bored (زهقت)
rows.why: Listening: he heard زهقت as زعلت (sad); Amal said 'زهقت مش زعلت' and he gave 'I was bored'.

rows.medi_said: They had fun or they enjoyed?
rows.amal_said: آآآ. Close بس that would be انبسطوا. انبسطوا
rows.why: Listening: Amal's item was the you-plural past (he corrected himself to 'you guys enjoyed' at 18:19 after her 'that would be انبسطوا' for 'they'); engine wrote the same spelling for both forms, so the slip is the past-tense person ending.

rows.medi_said: What boring hap-- What happened boring?
rows.amal_said: No، بيزعل، مش بيزهق.
rows.why: Listening: he heard بيزعل as بيزهق (bores); Amal said no, بيزعل not بيزهق, and he gave 'what sad thing happened'. His echo at 20:04 came out as بيساع (engine).

rows.medi_said: He will not, he will not bore you.
rows.amal_said: Very close. أزهقك، not يزهقك. أزهقك. ... I won't bore you. ما راح أزهقك.
rows.why: Listening: the a- (I) prefix on أزهقك heard as y- (he); Amal: 'أزهقك, not يزهقك' and gave 'I will not bore you'.

rows.medi_said: he will not be bored of you. Is that...
rows.amal_said: ما راح يكون زهقان منك. He will not be bored of you.
rows.why: Didn't-know: he asked how to say 'he will not be bored of you' and Amal supplied the sentence (ra7 ykoon + zah2aan + min).
rows.english: he won't be bored of you

rows.medi_said: Were you sad from what happened?
rows.amal_said: Very close. بس مش sad. انزعجتي. ... Did you get annoyed from what happened؟
rows.why: Listening: انزعجتي (got annoyed) rendered as 'sad'; Amal: 'مش sad' and he fixed to 'annoyed' (she also recast his 'are you' to 'did you get').
rows.english: did you get annoyed by what happened?

rows.medi_said: so don't be tired of me.
rows.amal_said: That's ما تتعبي مني. ما تعبيني. ... Don't tire me.
rows.why: Listening: the make-X command ما تعبيني (with -ni) read as the get-X 'be tired of me' (ما تتعبي مني); Amal contrasted them and he fixed to 'don't make me tired'.

rows.medi_said: She laughed at him.
rows.amal_said: علي. ... علي and عليه. إي، إي.
rows.why: Listening: 3alayy (on me) heard as 3aleh (on him); Amal re-said علي and he fixed; he admits 'I'm never gonna get LA and LAE'.

rows.medi_said: Who was he mad with you-- at you? I don't... This doesn't make sense.
rows.amal_said: What's ضايقك؟ ... So is it ضايق or it's ضايقة to be upset؟ ... So مين ضايقك؟
rows.wrong: Who was he mad at you
rows.why: Listening: ضايقك (upset you) read as عصب (mad at); Amal prompted 'What's ضايقك?' and he worked out 'who made you upset' at 28:17.

rows.medi_said: So بسطت is I was happy.
rows.amal_said: I made.
rows.why: Listening: basa6to (I made him happy, doubled middle) read as the get-X انبسطت; Amal: 'I made', he: 'this is inflicting... I made him happy' at 32:46.
rows.english: I made him happy / I cheered him up

rows.medi_said: You guys...
rows.amal_said: بينبسطوا.
rows.why: Listening: he started بينبسطوا as 'you guys'; Amal re-said the word and he gave 'they are happy when they see me' at 33:41.
rows.english: they get happy when they see me

rows.medi_said: ما تحمسي ... لسه ما... er ما تحمسي لسه
rows.amal_said: ما تتحمسي لسه.
rows.why: Production (Amal said 'Don't be excited yet' in English and told him to say it): he used the make-X stem ma t7ammasi (don't excite) for the get-X 'don't get excited'; Amal recast ما تتحمسي لسه and he repeated it ('Oh, that's right').

rows.medi_said: Wait. اتأسفوا لي. Yeah, they apologized. Present tense. Can I...
rows.amal_said: لأ. اتأسفوا، not بيتأسفوا.
rows.why: Listening: he labelled اتأسفوا لي as present; Amal: no, اتأسفوا not بيتأسفوا, and he agreed ('I said it with the first tense'). His echoes came out as 'أُمه safulu' / 'By all eight' (engine).

rows.medi_said: I ruined the, the s- the trip. ... Oh, khirbat. Uh, she ruined the trip.
rows.amal_said: Are you sure؟ I ruined؟ ... No؟ That would be خربت. خربت.
rows.wrong: I ruined the trip / she ruined the trip
rows.why: Listening: Amal's 5erbat el-safra (it got ruined) read as the make-X 5arrabet/5arrabat (someone ruined it); after two no's he got 'the trip was ruined' at 40:14, then produced إنتي خربتي السفرة right at 41:10.

rows.medi_said: Who, yeah, who was made happy or who enjoyed from us?
rows.amal_said: With us. معنا.
rows.why: Listening: معنا heard as منا; Amal recast 'With us. معنا' and he admitted 'I was saying mina'.

rows.medi_said: who was made happy by us?
rows.amal_said: انبسط.
rows.why: Listening: the n- get-X انبسط rendered as a 'was made happy by' passive; Amal re-said انبسط and he offered 'or who enjoyed' at 42:33.

rows.medi_said: Uh, are you excited to a girl?
rows.amal_said: Did you get excited؟
rows.why: Listening: past تحمستِ translated as present 'are you excited'; Amal recast 'Did you get excited?' and he took it ('Were you excited? Did you get excited?').

rows.medi_said: Why are you tired?
rows.amal_said: متعب. ... Mm-hmm. What's tired؟
rows.why: Listening: he read متعب (tiring) as تعبان (tired); Amal re-said متعب and asked 'What's tired?', he answered تعبان and re-read it as 'why is it tiring'.
rows.english: why is it / are you tiring?

rows.medi_said: بزهق ... بزهّق ... Is it zar-zarha, zar'a?
rows.amal_said: Yeah. That's boring. ... زهقان. Of course it's that's it. It's بس زهق، زهق.
rows.why: Asked 'what's bored?' (the adjective) he gave the verb forms بزهق / بزهّق; Amal said 'that's boring', he groped for the adjective ('zar'a') and she supplied زهقان which he repeated (sheet: bored | Zahqaan | زهقان) - a verb where the state word was wanted.

rows.medi_said: Not it as a don't be angry.
rows.amal_said: ما تتأسف.
rows.why: Listening: his first guess at ما تتأسف was 'don't be angry'; Amal repeated the item and he got 'Oh, أسف. Don't apologize' at 47:00.

rows.medi_said: uh, you guys don't, uh, don't be annoyed.
rows.amal_said: Annoyed؟
rows.why: Listening: زعل (be sad / upset) rendered as 'annoyed' (زعج); Amal queried 'Annoyed?' and he fixed to 'don't be sad from him'.

rows.medi_said: I enjoyed to it. No, Aloo, uh, Bill. Are you saying Bill? ... I got happy from him or to him?
rows.amal_said: No، انبسطت له. انبسطت له. Just the verb. I got happy له. ... For، for him.
rows.wrong: to it / from him or to him
rows.why: Listening: the la-/-lo on انبسطت له read as 'to / from him'; Amal: 'for him' and he landed on 'I got happy for him', then said انبسطت له himself at 51:08.

rows.medi_said: You guys don't be annoyed. ... you guys don't be annoying.
rows.amal_said: تزعجوه، not تنزعجوا، تزعجوه. ... توه، تزعجوه.
rows.why: Listening: make-X ما تزعجوه with the -o object read as the get-X ما تنزعجوا; Amal: 'تزعجوه not تنزعجوا' and pointed at the -o ('توه'), he got 'don't be annoying to him' at 53:17.

rows.medi_said: They made us sad.
rows.amal_said: زعلوني.
rows.why: Listening: the -ni object ending heard as -na; Amal re-said زعلوني and he fixed to 'They made me sad'.

rows.medi_said: So it made me happy...
rows.amal_said: بيب-ب-بيبسطني. ... صح، it made happy، بس is it past or present؟
rows.why: Listening: b- present بيبسطني translated as past 'made'; Amal asked past or present and he fixed to 'it makes me happy'.

rows.medi_said: you came. Aji, you said, "It makes me happy he came."
rows.amal_said: آجي. آجي. I come. It makes me happy like coming makes me happy.
rows.why: Listening: the bare I-form آجي after enno read as 'he came / you came' (wrong person and tense); Amal recast 'آجي. I come' and he got 'it's fun for me when I come'.
rows.english: it makes me happy that I come

rows.medi_said: Did, uh, did you guys enjoy to me? Did you guys... I don't understand this one.
rows.amal_said: انبسطولي. انبسطولي. ... They got-- they were happy for me.
rows.wrong: did you guys enjoy to me
rows.why: Listening: -u read as 'you guys' (it is they) and -li as 'to me' (it is for me); Amal repeated then gave 'they were happy for me' and he took it ('Oh, for me').
